name: How do I choose a reliable commercial sewage cleanup company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable commercial sewage cleanup company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a reliable commercial sewage cleanup company, look for certifications such as IICRC (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification), which indicates adherence to industry standards. Verify that the company is licensed and insured to protect your business from liability. Inquire about their experience specifically with commercial properties and sewage incidents. A reputable company should offer 24/7 emergency services, provide clear communication, and be transparent about their process and pricing. Ask for references and read customer reviews to gauge their professionalism and effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a reliable cleanup company by verifying IICRC certification, licensing, insurance, commercial experience, 24/7 availability, and positive customer references.
